news.headline: MAK Capital group discloses 7.8% passive ownership stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One and Michael A. Kaufman jointly reported 2,375,861 CLPT shares (7.8% of shares outstanding) with shared voting and dispositive power, up from a 6.3% stake disclosed earlier in the year. The increased passive stake shows continued institutional accumulation despite the post-earnings share-price weakness.

news.headline: Stifel cuts ClearPoint Neuro price target to $22 from $25 after Q2 miss and guidance cut
news.summary: Stifel maintained its Buy rating but trimmed its price target following Q2 revenue of $10.9M versus its own $12.9M estimate and the roughly 7% cut to full-year 2026 revenue guidance. The move reflects Wall Street recalibrating near-term expectations while still viewing the long-term gene-therapy delivery thesis intact.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M (+18%), misses estimates and cuts FY guidance to $48-52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose 18% to $10.9M but came in roughly $1.8M below consensus, with neurosurgery navigation/therapy up 62% to $5.6M while biologics and drug delivery fell 15% to $4.0M. Gross margin improved to 62%, yet opex jumped 51% to $17.0M, widening the net loss to $11.3M and cutting cash to $29.4M from $45.9M at year-end; FY2026 guidance was lowered to $48-52M.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro investor slides lay out $500M long-term revenue target amid Q2 miss
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 print, management presented a five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in annual revenue, centered on cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain, the ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories preclinical facility, focused ultrasound, robotics and Harmony 1.0 software. The company also framed the guidance cut as a deliberate pivot toward clinical case support and product development rather than traditional sales expansion.

news.headline: ClearPoint congratulates partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT designation for sasineprocel
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation to Aspen's autologous dopaminergic cell therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) for Parkinson's disease, based on the ongoing Phase 1/2a ASPIRO trial. The ClearPoint Navigation System and SmartFlow cannula are used for the transplantation procedure, so the designation (which brings potential priority review or accelerated approval) advances a second major partner program on ClearPoint's platform.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx partners with ClearPoint Neuro for targeted delivery of lead epilepsy gene therapy
news.summary: EpilepsyGTx selected the ClearPoint SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System to administer its lead candidate EPY201 in a planned first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial for focal refractory epilepsy. The deal adds another pharma partner to ClearPoint's gene-therapy delivery pipeline beyond the flagship uniQure program.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: uniQure confirmed after a Type B FDA meeting that it will submit the BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under accelerated approval in Q3 2026, using the 3-year Phase I/II analysis (75% slowing of cUHDRS progression vs. external controls) as the primary basis. ClearPoint's SmartFlow cannula and navigation platform is the delivery system, making this the single most important partner milestone for the CLPT thesis.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly print, expected in early November 2026 (date not yet formally announced). After the FY guidance cut to $48-52M, cash falling to $29.4M and Stifel's target reduction to $22, investors will watch whether biologics/drug-delivery services revenue (from the newly acquired CAL facility) reaccelerates as promised for Q3 and whether opex growth moderates.

catalysts.label: EpilepsyGTx EPY201 Phase 1/2a start
catalysts.detail: EpilepsyGTx plans a first-in-human Phase 1/2a trial of EPY201 for focal refractory epilepsy using ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Navigation System. Trial initiation would convert the July partnership announcement into actual procedure and service revenue.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience post-RMAT regulatory alignment
catalysts.detail: With RMAT designation in hand for sasineprocel, Aspen gains early and frequent FDA interactions and potential eligibility for accelerated approval in Parkinson's. Any announced pivotal trial design or expanded ASPIRO enrollment would add a second near-term approval pathway running on ClearPoint hardware.

catalysts.label: Partner trial ramp and ~10 data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 call to 10-15 clinical trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months, plus roughly 10 partner data readouts. This is the core driver of the biologics and drug-delivery revenue line and the main evidence needed to validate the $500M long-term revenue ambition.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA decision on AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Assuming a Q3 2026 filing with rolling/priority review, an FDA decision on the first Huntington's gene therapy could arrive around mid-2027. Approval would establish recurring per-procedure delivery revenue for ClearPoint and be the first commercial validation of the platform.

pulse: The story remains in show-me mode after the early-August guidance cut: Q2 revenue missed by ~$1.8M, opex jumped 51%, cash fell to $29.4M and FY2026 guidance was lowered to $48-52M, prompting Stifel to trim its price target to $22 (still Buy) even as management unveiled a long-term $500M revenue ambition built around gene-therapy delivery, the new CAL preclinical facility, focused ultrasound and robotics. Sentiment is mixed but not capitulating: a mid-August 13G/A shows MAK Capital increasing its stake to 7.8%, signalling patient institutional money is still accumulating through the weakness. Near term the stock trades on partner milestones rather than its own P&L - uniQure's confirmed Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130, Aspen's fresh RMAT designation in Parkinson's, and the ramp toward 10-15 enrolling partner trials - against a shrinking cash runway that keeps financing risk as the key offsetting factor to watch.
